items.title: Live: Iran's clerics could meet to choose a new leader within a day, as explosions heard in Tehran
items.description: A series of explosions has been heard in Tehran after Iran rejected the US president's demand for surrender. Follow live.

items.title: Trump promised peace but launched nine foreign military actions
items.description: The Australian government has avoided stating whether it supports or opposes many of Trump's operations.

items.title: Trump threatens to strike 'very hard' after Tehran rejects his 'dream' of Iran surrender
items.description: It came as Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian dismissed Mr Trump's demand for the country's surrender as a "dream" and apologised to Gulf states for missile and drone attacks.

items.title: Will higher fuel prices drive EV uptake? We crunched the numbers
items.description: As deepening conflict in the Middle East causes fuel prices to rise, will EVs boom? We've compared operating costs to see how they compare to petrol cars.

items.title: As a middle power Australia will have to stand up to allies
items.description: Middle powers may have a larger role to play in the emerging world order, but the same old dilemma persists: how far are they willing to defend the rules when the countries bending them are their closest allies?

items.title: A fall, a fracture and a death that didn't add up
items.description: Attila's shaky phone video of his brother lying dead in aged care documented bruises and blood. It was the start of a long campaign to understand what happened.

items.title: Reclaiming humanity post Bondi attack
items.description: Michael Visontay explores the deep roots of Jewish life in Bondi, and the impact of loss on this close-knit community.

items.title: SA government attributes email to wrong man after death, traumatising family
items.description: A grieving woman "feels sick" after the government releases an email it claims was written by her deceased partner praising his hospital care, after she said ambulance ramping had denied him dignity in his final hours.

items.title: Farrer's vast swathe of Coalition heartland 'at a crossroads' and up for grabs
items.description: The upcoming Farrer by-election is already being talked about as a litmus test for the new opposition leader and an ascendant One Nation. It'll also be a measure of major party politics.

items.title: Aussie Tudhope makes solid start in Winter Paralympics medal hunt
items.description: After claiming bronze four years ago in Beijing, Australia's Ben Tudhope impresses in the qualifying stage of the men's para snowboard program at the Milano Cortina Games.

items.title: What time the Australian Grand Prix starts and how to follow the race
items.description: Here's all you need to know about the F1 Australian Grand Prix, including when the race begins and the make-up of the starting grid.

items.title: Media personality, broadcaster, and Agro puppeteer Jamie Dunn dies aged 76
items.description: Dunn was a long-standing host of the B105 breakfast program but was known across the country as Agro — a puppet made out of a bath mat that rose to fame in 1990s.

items.title: Three charged after Good Samaritan's murder at Melbourne railway station
items.description: Two teenagers and a man have been charged after a 22-year-old died from stab wounds in Mernda on Friday night. Police are waiting to interview a fourth person about the death.

items.title: Promises ramped down in SA election as ambulance crisis proves hard to solve
items.description: With just two weeks to go until the state election, Labor has steered away from ambitious promises after difficulty meeting its pledge to fix the ambulance ramping crisis last election — one of the few points where the opposition's barbs are piercing.

items.title: 'You had to think on your feet': How Ranger Stacey became loved by Australian kids
items.description: Nineties kids didn't dawdle on the way home from school in the afternoon. This was the age of appointment television, and that appointment was with Ranger Stacey on Totally Wild.

items.title: Insist you're the best at trivia all you want — I know the truth
items.description: I'm so glad you're back for another round! Just kidding, as if I'd ever say that. Let's play, HARD!

items.title: All-ages heavy metal gigs offering 'freedom' for youths after COVID lockdowns
items.description: In community halls across Western Sydney young people are headbanging, crowdsurfing and forming mosh pits.

items.title: Calls to clear name of woman hanged for poisoning 'abusive' husband
items.description: Elizabeth Woolcock is recognised as the only women ever to be hanged in SA. But researchers believe she was sent to the gallows in 1873 an innocent woman.

items.title: Unlikely team of volunteers beats the odds to reopen community pool
items.description: While council pools across Victoria face threats of closure, residents of a rural town beat the odds to save theirs. Now they have to prove a community-run model can work.

items.title: Quick hits: Verstappen's big crash and Mercedes accused of sandbagging

items.title: Aussies hoping Healy bats one last time in Test farewell

items.title: 'I'm not a hero': Austin Appelbee reunited with rescuers who saved family
items.description: A WA family who made global headlines when they were rescued after being swept out to sea have been reunited with the local heroes who saved them.

items.title: Rapper-turned-politician Balen Shah defeats former PM in historic Nepal election
items.description: Balen Shah's Rastriya Swatantra Party is set to win a commanding share of parliamentary seats, defeating Nepal’s traditional political heavyweights.

items.title: Five must-see works from Newcastle Art Gallery's $145 million collection
items.description: The newly expanded gallery reopens with a blockbuster exhibition, Iconic Loved Unexpected, that places local artists alongside international stars.

items.title: Fans devastated over trouble in paradise for Kyle and Jackie O
items.description: An actress, electrician and real estate agent all have one thing in common – their love for Kyle and Jackie O. Here's why they've stuck by the pair through thick and thin.
